title: Colonial Reenactor Demonstrating to Tourists, 1950s Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-1950s black-and-white scalloped snapshot showing a costumed historical interpreter in colonial attire—complete with a tricorn hat, waistcoat, knee breeches, and stockings—speaking to a group of summer tourists beside a brick courtyard wall and artillery cannon, likely at Colonial Williamsburg. The crowd of visitors, dressed in post-war 1950s casual daywear, listens to the living history demonstration framed through the legs of a wooden cannon gin or gallows structure.
